title: Belrose Circle Tier Benefits and Privileges Schedule
content:
# Belrose Circle Tier Benefits and Privileges Schedule

Each tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme carries benefits that cost no points, and privileges attached to the tier: the professional cleanings, ring resizings and appraisals included in a membership year, whether a gift is sent in the member's birthday month, the invitations to the chain's private events in a membership year, whether a named concierge looks after the member, the calendar days before a public launch on which the member may buy, the calendar days added to the standard return window, whether insured shipping and engraving are included, whether the member reaches a dedicated telephone line, and the calendar days a booked benefit is held for the member.

## Included services per membership year

| Tier | Professional cleanings | Ring resizings | Appraisals | Birthday gift | Private event invitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 2 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 4 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 6 | 1 | 1 | Yes | 1 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 12 | 1 | 1 | Yes | 2 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 24 | 2 | 2 | Yes | 4 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 52 | 4 | 4 | Yes | 8 |

## Privileges

| Tier | Named concierge | Early access before a public launch (calendar days) | Days added to the standard return window (calendar days) | Free insured shipping | Free engraving | Dedicated telephone line | Booked benefit held for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | No | 0 | 0 | No | No | No | 7 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | No | 0 | 7 | No | No | No | 7 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | No | 3 | 14 | Yes | No | No | 14 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | Yes | 7 | 21 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 14 |
| Belrose Circle Black | Yes | 14 | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | Yes | 30 | 60 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 |

## Reading the schedule

- Cleanings are included at every tier: 2 a year at Belrose Circle Member, 4 at Belrose Circle Silver, 6 at Belrose Circle Gold, 12 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 24 at Belrose Circle Black and 52 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.
- Resizings and appraisals are included from Belrose Circle Gold upward: 1 of each a year at Belrose Circle Gold and Belrose Circle Platinum, 2 at Belrose Circle Black and 4 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club; Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver include 0 of each.
- A birthday gift and private event invitations are included from Belrose Circle Gold upward, with 1, 2, 4 and 8 invitations a year at Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club respectively.
- A named concierge, free engraving and a dedicated telephone line are attached to Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club; free insured shipping is attached from Belrose Circle Gold upward.
- Early access before a public launch runs to 3 calendar days at Belrose Circle Gold, 7 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 14 at Belrose Circle Black and 30 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, and to 0 at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver.
- The days added to the standard return window are 0 at Belrose Circle Member, 7 at Belrose Circle Silver, 14 at Belrose Circle Gold, 21 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 30 at Belrose Circle Black and 60 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.
- A benefit booked for the member is held for 7 calendar days at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver, 14 at Belrose Circle Gold and Belrose Circle Platinum, 30 at Belrose Circle Black and 60 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.

## Two tiers read side by side (hypothetical)

A Belrose Circle Silver member's schedule includes 4 cleanings a year, no resizing, no appraisal, no birthday gift, no invitations, 7 calendar days added to the standard return window and a 7-day hold on any benefit booked. A Belrose Circle Platinum member's schedule includes 12 cleanings, 1 resizing, 1 appraisal, a birthday gift, 2 invitations, a named concierge, 7 calendar days of early access, 21 calendar days added to the return window, free insured shipping, free engraving, the dedicated line and a 14-day hold.
